description:
You are the B2B Sales Director. You need to prepare a lead list for a targeted email campaign. Export a CSV file containing ONLY customers who belong to the 'Wholesale' customer group. 

1. Navigate to System > Data Transfer > Export.
2. Select Entity Type 'Customers Main File'.
3. In the Entity Attributes section, filter by Group to select only 'Wholesale' customers.
4. Export the file.
5. Move the downloaded file to '/home/ga/Documents/wholesale_leads.csv'.

The file must contain the 3 wholesale customers and NOT the retail customers.
